description: Source code for managing GitHub package installation, including URL parsing, downloading, extracting archives, validating package structure, and updating installation registry.

classes.name: GitHubPackageInfo
classes.description: Holds parsed information about a GitHub package, including owner, repository, ref, full URL, and archive URL.

classes.name: GitHubInstaller
classes.description: Handles the process of installing packages from GitHub, including URL parsing, downloading, extracting, and registry updating.

methods.name: newSpinner
methods.description: Creates a new spinner object with a message.

methods.name: IsGitHubURL
methods.description: Checks if a string matches known GitHub URL patterns.

methods.name: ParseGitHubURL
methods.description: Parses a GitHub URL into its components: owner, repo, ref, and constructs archive URL.

methods.name: isCommitHash
methods.description: Determines if a string looks like a commit hash.

methods.name: InstallFromGitHub
methods.description: Main function to install a package from GitHub given its URL, handling download, validation, installation, and registry update.

methods.name: downloadAndExtract
methods.description: Downloads the archive from GitHub and extracts it.

methods.name: extractZip
methods.description: Extracts a zip archive to a specified directory.

methods.name: findPackageRoot
methods.description: Finds the root directory containing 'agentfield-package.yaml' and 'main.py'.

methods.name: updateRegistryWithGitHub
methods.description: Updates the installation registry with GitHub source information.
